description: A massive plum-and-gold clockwork armored knight, seen from directly above, bearing a straight sword and crescent returning blade with a breathing crimson cape.
name: Warrior
notes: Portrait establishes plum armor, gold trim, clockwork ornament, crimson cloth, sword and crescent boomerang. This idle source contains no attack animation.
Eight distinct idle poses per cardinal direction: shoulders rise, clock hand ticks, cloth hem lags, and weapons counterbalance.
114 pixels equals six 19-pixel cells. Canvas and pivot are presentation dimensions, not collision or stats.
Cardinal directions are exact clockwise rotations of north; there is no visible frontal face, chest, standing boot or oblique camera.
